class.name: AIInterface
class.brief_description: Node for sending OpenAI-compatible chat completion requests.
class.description: [AIInterface] wraps [HTTPRequest] and exposes a simple scene node API for chat completion services that accept OpenAI-compatible [code]/chat/completions[/code] JSON requests.

method.name: cancel_request
method.description: Cancels the current HTTP request, if one is running.

method.name: is_requesting
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the internal HTTP client is connected or processing a request.

method.name: send_chat
method.description: Sends one user message. [member system_prompt] is added as a system message when it is not empty.

method.name: send_messages
method.description: Sends a complete chat messages array. Each item should be a dictionary with [code]role[/code] and [code]content[/code].

members.member: Base API URL. [code]/chat/completions[/code] is appended automatically when the URL does not already end with it.
Bearer token used for the Authorization header.
Maximum tokens requested from the model.
Model name sent in the request body.
Optional system prompt used by [method send_chat].
Sampling temperature sent in the request body.
If [code]true[/code], the internal [HTTPRequest] uses a worker thread.

signal.name: chat_completed
signal.description: Emitted when a chat request completes. [param content] contains the first choice text when it can be found.
